program.name: Active Flex Long
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Long sessions of strength at the end of your range, then long stretches.
program.about: Flexibility you can use. Each day is a circuit of strength at the end of your range, Cossack squats, Copenhagen planks and knee holds one day, Y raises, wall slides and snow angels the next, then long stretches for the same areas. They alternate. Level II holds every stretch longer and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Hip range circuit & stretch / shoulder range circuit & stretch, long
